svg.text: Calm, precise, approachable. Demonstrates every movement slowly and cleanly.
— Modelled eyes with lids, brows, nose, lips and ears — not painted on.
— The three expressions above are built in as blend shapes.
— Built from scratch in Blender to this sheet — no base mesh, scan or template.
— Front and side views are orthographic on one head-unit grid, so they are traced 1:1.
— Hands: five articulated fingers; closes to a fist for the boxing guard.
— Clothing is separate geometry with real hems, collar and waistband.
— Trainers: upper, midsole, outsole, heel tab and laces as separate parts.
— Soft two-tone shading as drawn here; 25–35k triangles for mid-range phones.
— Same skeleton and clip names as the current trainer — no app changes.
Original design for MOTIONFORGE · light from upper left · units: cm
